body_en: Nature systems connect: soil, water, plants, animals, weather. Change one part and others shift. Observe a park or river through a season and keep notes. Wonder is the start of careful science.
body_zh: 自然系统相连：土壤、水、植物、动物、天气。动一部分，其它会变。跨一个季节观察公园或河流并做笔记。好奇是谨慎科学的起点。
